$comment: External assets approved by the user. scripts/data/fetch-assets.mjs downloads the 'api' entries into assets-src/<kind>/<id>/ and lists the 'manual' ones in .docs/assets/manual-downloads.md. repeat_m is the real-world size of one texture tile or decal [width, height] in metres (null when the source does not state it). resolution is the requested download resolution (null when the source fixes it).
